transcript.text: Now compute net revenue for West region (focus region) in calendar year 2025, completed orders only.

args.sql:
SELECT SUM(o.amount - o.discount) AS net_cents, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'West'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'

Used memory.bench.orders directly (not daily_region_revenue, which is gross-only and stale after 2025-11-30) per the Revenue Reporting Policy (kp-bench-1).
